author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Name: Epic Proelio

By: DaBaderMC & resepignev

How Long It Took: Erhm.... month xD Its my first map, sorry.

Feature 1: There are 3 very detailed and unique monuments for each team. Each team gets 3 monuments, Right, Left, Back.

Feature 2: In the middle of the map, under that lapis design there are iron & diamond blocks! 

Gameplay: There could be many things to do in this map...Lets say 1 team got most of the diamond blocks, they could start up a farm. But you could also use tactical ways to DTM!

Images:http://imgur.com/auGzbtH,VRecnhh,Pz3xAwp,3iH1ASD,uBzna8z,V1qZh1U,EvrayDc,LMPAFr7#7

Download:http://www.mediafire.com/download/eo3fr8rz2lju362/Epic+Proelio.zip
YAML: http://pastebin.com/gyGZ8wgQ
